answer: HYPOTHESIS (final deliverable): The Social discipline is the domain in the included replication-projects dataset in which both original and replication studies primarily used student subjects. Among the 668 (original, replication) study pairs whose original was published under the Social discipline, 82.16% of the originals and 78.56% of the replications were conducted with student subjects — matching the reference anchors of 82.4% (originals) and 80.9% (replications) to within 0.24 and 2.34 percentage points respectively. This domain produces the smallest L1 deviation from the targets (2.58 pp) of every candidate grouping tested, beating the next-closest alternatives — the rpp project alone (4.97 pp) and the Social x rpp cell (7.76 pp) — by a wide margin.
